title: VACE: Learning Geometrically Structured Representations for Time Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2605.23504v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Anomaly detection in multivariate time series is a critical task across a wide range of real-world applications, where abnormal behaviour is rare, labels are unavailable, and the cost of a miss is high. The central challenge is learning a characterisation of normality precise enough to flag deviations. Representation self-supervised learning, typically through contrastive approaches, addresses this by embedding temporal patches into a latent space where normality occupies a well-defined region, with anomalies detected by geometric deviation. However, contrastive approaches shape this space indirectly through pair-sampling heuristics, providing no explicit control over the geometric structure on which distance-based scoring operates. translated_title: VACE：为时间序列异常检测学习几何结构化表示
translated_abstract: 多变量时间序列中的异常检测是众多现实应用中的一项关键任务，在这些场景中异常行为稀少、标签不可用，且漏检的代价高昂。核心挑战在于学习一种足够精确的正常性刻画，以便标记偏差。表示自监督学习（通常采用对比方法）通过将时间片段嵌入潜空间来解决这一问题，在该空间中正常性占据一个明确定义的区域，并通过几何偏差来检测异常。然而，对比方法通过成对采样启发式间接地塑造这一空间，无法对基于距离评分所依赖的几何结构进行显式控制，因此这种几何结构只能听凭运气。我们提出了VACE（速度对齐通道嵌入），这是一种自监督异常检测方法，它将正常性表示为局部平滑、方向连贯的……
tldr: VACE提出了一种自监督异常检测方法，通过速度对齐通道嵌入显式塑造潜空间几何结构，将正常性表示为局部平滑、方向连贯的表示，克服了对比学习无法显式控制距离评分所依赖几何结构的缺陷。
en_tdlr: VACE is a self-supervised anomaly detection method that explicitly shapes the latent space geometry through velocity-aligned channel embeddings, representing normality as locally smooth, directionally coherent representations to overcome contrastive learning's lack of explicit control over the geometry underlying distance-based scoring.
